PASSIVE_PROPHYLAXIS_MISSED_LEVER.title: Passive Prophylaxis Over Active Pawn Levers
PASSIVE_PROPHYLAXIS_MISSED_LEVER.otb_signal: Opponent pushes wing pawns aggressively (e.g., ...g5) with an uncastled king, or prepares to trade off your strongest central piece.
PASSIVE_PROPHYLAXIS_MISSED_LEVER.otb_action: Before touching your king or making a quiet retreat, calculate every immediate pawn lever (h4, f4, c4) and forcing piece challenge first.

PIECE_QUALITY_NEGLECT.title: Leaving Restricted Minor Pieces Unimproved
PIECE_QUALITY_NEGLECT.otb_signal: One of your minor pieces is hemmed in by your own central pawn chain.
PIECE_QUALITY_NEGLECT.otb_action: Look for a 2-step reroute (e.g., Ba3-d6) to trade off or activate your worst piece before initiating wing contact.

RECAPTURE_AVOIDANCE_CONCESSION.title: Avoiding Forced Recaptures & Conceding Dangerous Passers
RECAPTURE_AVOIDANCE_CONCESSION.otb_signal: Opponent captures near your king (e.g., ...hxg3+) and only one recapture eliminates the intruder.
RECAPTURE_AVOIDANCE_CONCESSION.otb_action: Never reject the natural recapture on intuition—calculate the forced exchange sequence all the way to the quiet board and compare against leaving the enemy passer alive.

SHARP_TACTICAL_HORIZON.title: Deep Tactical Calculation Horizon
SHARP_TACTICAL_HORIZON.otb_signal: Both kings are exposed with heavy pieces on open files and candidate moves diverge sharply.
SHARP_TACTICAL_HORIZON.otb_action: Switch from general positional rules to strict candidate-move elimination: list checks, captures, and rook lifts at every ply.
